title: Snazzie FM News: The Going-Out-Of-Business Hour
description: Dale and Marsha read the top of the hour, completely deadpan: a soup declared a going concern, HonkHeal's interior growth, and the fog's small-business license.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Good evening. This is Snazzie F M News. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Our lead story tonight, the local economy, which is closing, and also thriving.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: We begin at Donna's Diner, where auditors have declared the ninety-year soup a going concern. The soup may now legally outlive the staff, and Donna.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Donna could not be reached. The soup declined to comment, but did continue.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: HonkHeal has opened a third location inside its second location, citing aggressive interior growth. Regulators describe the site as mostly waiting room.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Staff are advised not to go in too deep.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Still developing tonight, the fog's small-business license. The fog filed last week. It wishes to incorporate, so it can pay rent. The city clerk has not returned its calls.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: We'll stay on that. <p:0.3> And finally, an update on the fog. Its license was approved this afternoon.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: The fog has leased the entire block and retained all current tenants. It asks that you continue shopping local.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: The fog thanks you for your patronage. For Snazzie F M News, I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Good night.
